Warschau den 5t Maerz 1812.
Lieber Bruder
Ich eile dich zu benachrichtigen, daß ich verschie¬
dner Geschäfte wegen erst den 15t d. M. aus
Warschau werde ausfahren können. Die Sache
wegen Trąbczyn steht eingezogenen zuverläßigen
Nachrichten zu folge recht gut, worüber ich dir
mündlich ein Mehreres sagen werde.
wegen Kürze der Zeit, da die Gelegenheit ab¬
geht, kann ich Dir nicht mehr schreiben
Leb wol
dem Freund und Brude[r]
Brzechffa

translation.en:
Warsaw, the 5th of March 1812.

Dear Brother, I hasten to inform you that, on account of various matters of business, I shall not be able to set out from Warsaw until the 15th of this month. The affair concerning Trąbczyn stands, according to the reliable intelligence I have gathered, quite well, of which I shall tell you more by word of mouth. For shortness of time, as the conveyance is departing, I cannot write you more. Farewell

to the friend and brothe[r]

Brzechffa

text_english:
Warsaw, the 5th of March 1812.

Dear Brother, I hasten to inform you that, on account of various matters of business, I shall not be able to set out from Warsaw until the 15th of this month. The affair concerning Trąbczyn stands, according to the reliable intelligence I have gathered, quite well, of which I shall tell you more by word of mouth. For shortness of time, as the conveyance is departing, I cannot write you more. Farewell

to the friend and brothe[r]

Brzechffa
summary_de: Brzechffa teilt Triebenfeld mit, dass er wegen verschiedener Geschäfte erst am 15. des Monats aus Warschau abreisen kann. Nach eingezogenen zuverlässigen Nachrichten steht die Sache wegen Trąbczyn recht gut. Näheres will er mündlich berichten. Wegen der abgehenden Gelegenheit schreibt er nur kurz.

reading.notes: Short note from Brzechffa in Warsaw to Triebenfeld, whom he calls "Bruder". He can leave Warsaw only on the 15th of the month because of other business. He has reliable information that the Trąbczyn matter stands well and will tell more in person. A Polish copy (72e) confirms the content. The previous letter shows Brzechffa was in Warsaw pursuing the Trąbczyn restitution with Prefect Garczynski.
